title: Sergeant Larson's onion speech on secrecy
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Sergeant Larson's onion speech on secrecy, about early 1990s at Overseas base detachment, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: during our during our black introduction. He went into the onion thing.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for intercepted signals, had him communicate with aliens, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a moment in the early 1990s at a base overseas. He says that while he was being brought into a 'black' programme, one so secret it is officially hidden, a Sergeant Larson gave a talk comparing secrecy to an onion, with layers inside layers, a story he also tells in his book Above Black. He tells it to explain how people inside such programmes see only their own layer.
